About Pactrail

Trust should be designed into the transaction.

Pactrail is building the assurance layer for commerce between unfamiliar wallets, organizations and autonomous agents.

From wallet intelligence to enforceable protection.

Onchain commerce makes settlement global, fast and programmable—but counterparties still rely on screenshots, social reputation and blind upfront payments.

Pactrail treats observable wallet behavior as context, not identity. We compile that context into the minimum safeguards a specific transaction needs: escrow, milestones, delays, limits or review.

Nansen provides the behavioral intelligence. Pactrail supplies the policy language, transaction controls and outcome proofs.

01

Specific, not universal

We evaluate the proposed transaction rather than assigning a permanent score to a person or wallet.

02

Explainable by default

Every recommended control is connected to an observable signal and plain-language reason.

03

Protection over prediction

We do not promise who will behave well. We structure agreements so uncertainty causes less harm.
